A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown the feasibility of using the TCCON as an accurate source of global CO2 data.
the TCCON measurements of CO2, CH4, and N2O are consistent with WMO scales within the measurement uncertainties.
the TCCON measurements of total columns of CO2, CH4 and CO are accurate to within 1.0, 0.8, and 0.6%, respectively, and the TCCON water vapor data are accurate to within about 2.5%.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the TCCON can be calibrated using in situ data with a single, global scaling factor for each gas.
the TCCON is a robust network that can be calibrated using aircraft profiles to a high level of precision.
the TCCON data can be used with high confi- dence to derive global and regional carbon cycle and climate change trends.
